remarks: Pristine four-bedroom raised ranch in the countryside with Free Gas. Set on two wooded lots totaling 6 acres, this home offers a private, peaceful environment that is hard to find. Inside, the home has four roomy bedrooms, three on the main floor and one in the partially finished lower level.  The primary bedroom has an en-suite bath, a large closet, and a gorgeous view of the back yard. The kitchen is spacious with ample workspace, stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast bar. The main floor also has a dining room with a sliding glass door onto the deck, and a living room with lots of warm, natural light. There are two full bathrooms on the main floor. The basement has a fourth bedroom and a huge recreation room that could serve as a second, less formal living room, a game room, or a home gym. The unfinished part of the basement houses the laundry hookups and a washtub sink. The home is also equipped with central A/C. Outside, the home has a deck with steps into the backyard. It's easy to imagine the summertime gatherings that could be hosted here. The house has an attached two-car garage, but there is also a second detached two-car garage with its own electrical and water service. It is spacious enough to provide storage and workshop space for larger projects, while still holding two cars. The home has free gas, and the current owner reports that it's been enough to heat a pool in previous years.  There is an outlet and a gas line in the backyard, so if you want to put in a pool, the gas and power are already there.
